Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study performs two types of proteomics: a general cellular proteome and a ribosomal proteome (isolated via sucrose cushion ultracentrifugation). While the paper discusses rRNA pseudouridylation (psi) extensively, this is performed via HydraPsiSeq (RNA-seq), not mass spectrometry. The MS analysis is standard bottom-up LFQ of proteins.

scope: For the analyses of the ribosomal proteome, SNORA33 KO and CRISPR control cell pools were pre-incubated with CHX (100 µg/mL, Sigma-Aldrich, C1988) for 5 min at 37 °C and harvested by scraping in cold NaCl (0.9%) supplemented with CHX (100 µg/mL).

Equal amounts of cytoplasmic extracts were loaded on low-salt sucrose cushions for the isolation of ribosomes and associated proteins (1 M and 0.7 M sucrose cushion; 20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 25 mM NaCl) and ultracentrifuged at 32.200 rpm at 4 °C for 17 h (SW 41 Ti rotor, Beckman-Coulter, 331362).

The ribosomal pellet was resuspended in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer (Sigma-Aldrich, 09830) supplemented with 7.5U of Benzonase Nuclease (Merck Millipore, 70664-3) and a protease inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich, 11836170001) and flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen.
